EC1: Any significant acute [OR] or chronic medical illness or problem, including, but not limited to, diabetes [OR], hypertension [OR], cardiac disease [OR], asthma [OR], chronic obstructive lung disease
EC2: Current or recent (last 60 days) tobacco [OR] or nicotine use
EC3: History of sickle cell [OR] trait [OR] or disease or any other acquired [OR] or hereditary hematological abnormality
EC4: History of fainting [OR] or other significant adverse reaction during phlebotomy [OR] or donation of blood
EC5: Known prolonged QTc [AND] (or evidence of such at screening) on electrocardiogram defined as >470 ms
EC6: Known or suspected illicit drug [OR] or alcohol abuse
EC7: Known or suspected HIV [OR], Hepatitis B [OR], or Hepatitis C infection
EC8: History of thrombophilia [OR] or anticoagulant therapy
EC11: Recent history of blood donation: a) Single whole blood unit donation within the past 8 weeks; b) Double RBC donation by apheresis within the past 16 weeks; or c) Plasma donation by apheresis within the past 4 weeks
EC12: Inadequate RBC mass based on TBV [OR] <4500 ml (above) or screening Hb <14 g/dL
